title: About A Pulse Inside the Opening
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1216 recent saved-signal files and 949 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Cobalt Dawn, by Shinji Wakasa and slice split, by available on computers / Dylan Kerr, plus 7 more. A source image from f4.bcbits.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became A Pulse Inside the Opening: Nocturnal optical cinematic still, frontal deep-field tableau: two unequal ivory loop-and-hinge groups hover across broad olive-black darkness. Split the blunt lower-right silhouette into cropped masses; lift one against the depth order. After the image was made, the mask pass used geometry and contour candidates to attach source windows to the visible marks.
